decision.explanation: The provided evidence (pmid-27167191) exclusively investigates the efficacy of MEK and CDK4/6 inhibitors (specifically MEK162/trametinib and palbociclib) in KRAS mutant colorectal cancer (CRC). The study does not mention lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma, EZH2 activating mutations, or the drug Tazemetostat. Therefore, there is no evidence to support, revise, or refute the claim regarding EZH2 mutations and Tazemetostat resistance in lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma.
